title: A Simple Cake
text:
Maria wants to make a simple cake. First, she gets eggs, flour, sugar, and milk. She puts all the things in a big bowl. She mixes them for five minutes.

Next, she pours the mix into a round pan. She puts the pan in the oven for thirty minutes. When the cake is ready, it is golden and warm. Maria shares it with her family.

questions.text: What does Maria put the ingredients in?
How long does the cake stay in the oven?
How does Maria probably feel about the finished cake?
What can the reader guess about the cake before it goes in the oven?

vocabulary.definition: a deep round dish used for mixing food
stirs different things together until they are one
a warm yellow-brown color, like toast
the people you live with or are related to

paragraph_translations: María quiere hacer un pastel sencillo. Primero, consigue huevos, harina, azúcar y leche. Pone todas las cosas en un bol grande. Lo mezcla durante cinco minutos.
Después, vierte la mezcla en un molde redondo. Pone el molde en el horno durante treinta minutos. Cuando el pastel está listo, está dorado y tibio. María lo comparte con su familia.
